content:
ChatManager持久化改造完成：
1. chat_manager.py：加data_dir参数，_load_rooms/_save_rooms持久化到chat_rooms.json，members改user_id集合，新增get_user_rooms/get_client_by_user_id方法，create/join/leave/delete后调_save_rooms
2. app.py：WebSocketConnectionManager加data_dir参数传给ChatManager，新增/api/chat/user-rooms HTTP GET路由，_handle_chat_create_room传user_id
3. App.vue：新增restoreChatRoomsFromServer函数，chat_register_response后调API恢复房间
4. 持久化文件路径：~/.jarvis/chat/chat_rooms.json
5. unregister_client不删members保持久化，broadcast_to_room按user_id查在线client
